name: one-plain-ui
title: One plain UI, rendered from the shared relations
html:
One plain UI, rendered from the shared relations

Green: offered now. Grey: not in this state (merged). One renderer, no forge-specific code: it reads the media type, as a browser reads HTML.
say: The gateway serves each resource as text/html too. It's a plain, functional UI, rendered only from the data, the typed relations and the forms offered now. Nothing in the renderer knows GitHub or GitLab. Here, both merged: green buttons are the forms offered now, grey ones are not offered in this state. scm:comment is lit on both.
